drivers: Three independent attributes (count, shape, rotation) must each be resolved; distractors are all one- or two-attribute near misses
Rules are simple arithmetic progressions (count +1, rotation +45°) and a shape/fill cycle, so each is individually easy to spot
Zero-count cell appears blank, which can confuse rule discovery for the count attribute
105 s is adequate but combining three rules under time pressure penalizes lower-ability test-takers
